description: JavaScript/TypeScript SDK that embeds the ONLYOFFICE Apps (DocSpace) file manager, document editor and viewer, file and room selectors, uploader, forms gallery and AI chat into a web application via an iframe with postMessage communication. npm: @onlyoffice/docspace-sdk-js.
rules: Install @onlyoffice/docspace-sdk-js, create `new SDK()` and call a mode wrapper: initManager, initEditor, initViewer, initRoomSelector, initFileSelector, initSystem, initPublicRoom, initUploader, initForms, initChat or initPersonal. In a <script> tag the same API is `DocSpace.SDK.initFrame` with a `mode` field.
`frameId` and `src` (the ONLYOFFICE Apps portal URL) are the only required TFrameConfig fields; editor, viewer, uploader and forms modes also need `id`, public-room needs `requestToken`.
The host application's domain must be added to the workspace allowlist (Developer Tools -> Embed SDK), otherwise the frame does not load.
Instance methods return promises that reject with SDKError (SDKErrorCode) after `methodTimeout`, 30 s by default; `login` and `createRoom` resolve with a `status` field that must be checked.
Event handlers go into `events` in the config (onAppReady, onAppError, onSelectCallback, onNavigate, ...); do not attach window `message` listeners yourself.
